title.fr: Le courant du secteur (dangers et sécurité)

sketch:
Observe (read): short primer on domestic AC supply — 230 V effective,
50 Hz, phase/neutre/terre wires, safety devices (disjoncteur, prise
de terre, différentiel). SVG cutaway of a wall outlet + a fuse box
as illustration. Evaluate: 5 concept cards covering typical safety
scenarios (why the third-pin? why does a wet hand matter? what
trips the differential? etc.). No Experiment stage — this is a
literacy/safety topic, not a physics simulation.
